name: io.github.agentc22/x402engine-mcp
description: Agent-friendly x402engine MCP server with automatic capped USDC payments on Base and Solana.

environmentVariables.name: X402_DEV_BYPASS
environmentVariables.description: Dev bypass secret to skip payments during testing

environmentVariables.name: X402_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Payer private key for automatic Base USDC payments

environmentVariables.name: X402_SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Base58 or JSON payer key for automatic Solana USDC payments

environmentVariables.name: X402_PAYMENT_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Payment network preference: auto, base, or solana (default: auto)

environmentVariables.name: X402_MAX_PAYMENT_USD
environmentVariables.description: Hard maximum payment per request in USD (default: 1.00)

packages.runtimeHint: Uses stdio and calls the live x402engine gateway. Configure a payer wallet for automatic x402 payment; every payment is constrained by X402_MAX_PAYMENT_USD.
